title: noresourcepack
description: Hypixel skyblock added a new forced texture pack, this removes the "forced" part
body:
# NoResourcePack
Hypixel Skyblock added a new forced resource pack, this mod allows you to remove the "forced" part of the resource pack.

this mod also allows you to choose between different textures of the resource pack (you must accept the texture pack first for this feature) with a keybind or command to toggle each individual texture for a specific item.

# Commands
/nrp tooltip - disables the custom tool tip

/nrp whitelist <skyblockId> - adds a skyblockId to the whitelist of items that you prefer the Hypixel texture over

/nrp blacklistmode - enables the blacklist mode which "whitelists" all the items from hypixel texture pack but whenever you hit the "whitelist" keybind it allows it to use the vanilla texture instead

# Credits
